words.enDefinition: a US federal grant for eligible students, primarily undergraduates with financial need

examples.en: The adviser explained why the Federal Pell Grant was listed separately from the university's scholarship.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么「美国联邦佩尔助学金」和学校的奖学金是分开列的。

examples.en: Our class used a sample Federal Pell Grant notice to compare grants and student loans.
examples.zh: 课堂上我们拿一份「美国联邦佩尔助学金」样本通知比较助学金与学生贷款。

collocations: qualify for a Federal Pell Grant

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦补充教育机会助学金
words.enDefinition: a need-based US federal grant administered by participating schools for eligible undergraduates with exceptional financial need
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦补充教育机会助学金

examples.en: The aid office listed a Federal Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant on the sample award notice.
examples.zh: 助学办公室在资助样本通知上列出了一项「美国联邦补充教育机会助学金」。

examples.en: Our US college adviser explained how the Federal Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant differed from a loan.
examples.zh: 美国大学的顾问解释了「美国联邦补充教育机会助学金」和贷款的区别。

collocations: receive a Federal Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant
award a Federal Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant
funding for the Federal Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant

words.enDefinition: a US federal grant for eligible teacher education students that has a teaching service obligation

examples.en: The TEACH Grant section of the handbook explained that the grant came with a service obligation.
examples.zh: 手册的「美国教师教育资助」一节说明，这项助学金带有任教服务义务。

examples.en: We compared the TEACH Grant with a scholarship offered by the university's school of education.
examples.zh: 我们把「美国教师教育资助」和大学教育学院提供的奖学金作了比较。

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦勤工助学计划
words.enDefinition: a US federal aid programme that supports part-time employment for eligible students with financial need
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦勤工助学计划

examples.en: The financial aid offer listed Federal Work-Study separately from the grant that covered course fees.
examples.zh: 助学金方案把「美国联邦勤工助学计划」和用于支付课程费用的助学金分开列出。

examples.en: A staff member explained how campus positions were advertised to students with Federal Work-Study eligibility.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了学校怎样向符合「美国联邦勤工助学计划」资格的学生发布校内岗位。

words.zhGloss: 美国《高教法》第四章资助
words.enDefinition: US federal student aid provided under Title IV of the Higher Education Act
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国《高教法》第四章资助

examples.en: The university's financial aid handbook explained which awards in the example counted as Title IV aid.
examples.zh: 大学的助学手册解释了例子里哪些资助属于「美国《高教法》第四章资助」。

examples.en: The adviser reviewed the Title IV aid entries when explaining my two scholarship notices.
examples.zh: 顾问解释我的两份奖学金通知时，查看了其中的「美国《高教法》第四章资助」条目。

words.enDefinition: a student or other required person who provides information and completes an assigned part of a US FAFSA form

examples.en: The student's parent was a FAFSA contributor and completed a separate section of the online form.
examples.zh: 家长是「FAFSA 资料提供人」，填写了在线表格中分开的一个部分。

examples.en: The adviser explained what each FAFSA contributor was responsible for on the sample student aid application.
examples.zh: 顾问用助学申请样表解释了每位「FAFSA 资料提供人」各负责什么。

words.enDefinition: an invitation asking a required person to complete their section of a US FAFSA form

examples.en: The student checked whether the contributor invitation had reached the parent listed on the form.
examples.zh: 学生查看了「资料提供人填写邀请」是否已送到表里登记的家长那里。

examples.en: The aid office showed us where the contributor invitation appeared in the application status page.
examples.zh: 助学办公室指给我们看，「资料提供人填写邀请」在申请状态页的什么位置。

words.zhGloss: 资料提供人的信息披露同意与授权
words.enDefinition: a FAFSA contributor's agreement to share identifying information and authorise the receipt, use and permitted onward disclosure of federal tax information
acceptedZhAnswers: 资料提供人的信息披露同意与授权

examples.en: The sample FAFSA showed a separate section for contributor consent and approval before the signature.
examples.zh: FAFSA 样表在签名之前单设了一个「资料提供人的信息披露同意与授权」栏。

examples.en: The adviser explained contributor consent and approval while showing us how the sample application was organised.
examples.zh: 顾问展示申请样表的结构时，解释了「资料提供人的信息披露同意与授权」。

words.enDefinition: a correction made to information on a submitted US federal student aid application

examples.en: I read the sample FAFSA correction notice to see which part of the record had changed.
examples.zh: 我读了「FAFSA 表格更正」样本通知，看看哪部分记录改了。

examples.en: The aid adviser asked whether the FAFSA correction had already appeared on the application's details page.
examples.zh: 助学顾问问，申请详情页是不是已经显示「FAFSA 表格更正」。

words.zhGloss: 院校学生助学信息记录
words.enDefinition: the electronic record that US schools receive with processed FAFSA information and eligibility data
acceptedZhAnswers: 院校学生助学信息记录

examples.en: Our training used an Institutional Student Information Record with made-up information to explain verification flags.
examples.zh: 我们用一份含模拟数据的「院校学生助学信息记录」培训，了解各种核验标记。

examples.en: The aid officer compared the Institutional Student Information Record with the applicant's updated documentation.
examples.zh: 助学工作人员将「院校学生助学信息记录」与申请人更新后的材料作了比对。

collocations: receive an Institutional Student Information Record
review an Institutional Student Information Record
update the Institutional Student Information Record

words.enDefinition: the US federal system that processes FAFSA applications and related student aid data

examples.en: The handbook explains when the FAFSA Processing System sends a processed record to a listed school.
examples.zh: 手册解释了「FAFSA 处理系统」何时把处理过的记录发给表中所列学校。

examples.en: Our training chart showed where the FAFSA Processing System fits between the application and the school.
examples.zh: 培训图上标明了「FAFSA 处理系统」在提交申请和学校收件之间所处的位置。

collocations: data from the FAFSA Processing System
the FAFSA Processing System generates a record
the FAFSA Processing System sends results

words.enDefinition: a worksheet used by a school to collect information for checking details on a FAFSA application

examples.en: An adviser showed us a blank FAFSA verification worksheet during the workshop on aid notices.
examples.zh: 讲解资助通知的工作坊上，顾问给我们看了一张空白的「FAFSA 核验表」。

examples.en: The FAFSA verification worksheet asked for supporting information about items selected for review that year.
examples.zh: 「FAFSA 核验表」要求为当年抽查的项目提供佐证资料。

words.enDefinition: a US federal aid classification specifying which FAFSA items a selected applicant must verify

examples.en: The verification tracking group indicated which parts of the sample application needed additional documents.
examples.zh: 「资助核验分组」表明，申请样本的哪些部分需要补充文件。

examples.en: I learned to locate the verification tracking group in the practice version of the school's record.
examples.zh: 我学会了在学校的练习版记录中找到「资助核验分组」。

words.zhGloss: 助学评估的特殊财务情况
words.enDefinition: in US federal student aid, financial circumstances that may warrant reviewing aid calculation data or costs
acceptedZhAnswers: 助学评估的特殊财务情况

examples.en: The adviser discussed special circumstances such as a substantial change in family income during the year.
examples.zh: 顾问讨论了「助学评估的特殊财务情况」，例如家庭收入在年内发生较大变化。

examples.en: The aid office's notice listed examples of special circumstances that might affect the cost estimate.
examples.zh: 助学办公室的通知举了几种可能影响费用估算的「助学评估的特殊财务情况」。

collocations: report special circumstances to the aid office

words.zhGloss: 可能影响受抚养身份的特殊情况
words.enDefinition: in US federal student aid, circumstances that may justify changing a student's dependency status
acceptedZhAnswers: 可能影响受抚养身份的特殊情况

examples.en: The handbook discussed unusual circumstances in a separate section about decisions on student dependency status.
examples.zh: 手册在资助依赖身份判定的独立章节讨论了「可能影响受抚养身份的特殊情况」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how unusual circumstances differed from a change in a student's documented financial costs.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「可能影响受抚养身份的特殊情况」与已登记的学生费用变动有何区别。

words.zhGloss: 资助依赖身份个别改判
words.enDefinition: a US financial aid decision changing a student's classification from dependent to independent in qualifying unusual circumstances
acceptedZhAnswers: 资助依赖身份个别改判

examples.en: The aid handbook defined a dependency override when discussing reviews of a student's application status.
examples.zh: 助学手册在讲申请状态复核时，给出了「资助依赖身份个别改判」的定义。

examples.en: The dependency override case in our training showed why the original classification had been reviewed.
examples.zh: 培训中的「资助依赖身份个别改判」案例解释了为什么对原分类作了复核。

words.zhGloss: 资助人员个案酌情判断
words.enDefinition: in US financial aid, a qualified administrator's discretion to make certain case-specific adjustments under programme rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 资助人员个案酌情判断

examples.en: The adviser used professional judgment to review the documented cost of attendance in our sample case.
examples.zh: 在示例案例中，顾问依据「资助人员个案酌情判断」复核了材料里的就学总费用。

examples.en: Our workshop explained when the phrase professional judgment appears in federal financial aid guidance.
examples.zh: 工作坊解释了联邦助学指南在哪些情况下会出现「资助人员个案酌情判断」这个说法。

words.enDefinition: a change to the expense estimate a school uses when calculating student financial aid

examples.en: The aid office discussed a cost of attendance adjustment after reviewing receipts for required equipment.
examples.zh: 助学办公室审阅必备器材的收据后，讨论了「就学总费用调整」。

examples.en: The revised transport estimate appeared beneath a cost of attendance adjustment on my notice.
examples.zh: 我收到的通知在「就学总费用调整」下面列出了修改后的交通费用估算。

collocations: request a cost of attendance adjustment
review a cost of attendance adjustment
approve a cost of attendance adjustment

words.enDefinition: temporary treatment as an independent student on a FAFSA record while eligibility is being reviewed

examples.en: The sample application had provisional independent status while the aid office reviewed the student's circumstances.
examples.zh: 助学办公室复核学生情况时，示例申请显示「暂定独立资助身份」。

examples.en: The student had provisional independent status pending the financial aid office's final determination.
examples.zh: 在资助办公室作出最终认定之前，该学生具有「暂定独立资助身份」。

words.enDefinition: the list of institutions designated to receive an applicant's processed FAFSA information

examples.en: The student checked the FAFSA school list after adding another university to the application.
examples.zh: 将另一所大学加到申请中后，学生查看了「FAFSA 接收院校名单」。

examples.en: The FAFSA school list in our practice form contained only two universities in the same state.
examples.zh: 练习表里的「FAFSA 接收院校名单」只列了同一州的两所大学。

collocations: add a college to the FAFSA school list

words.zhGloss: 佩尔助学金终身资格已用比例
words.enDefinition: the percentage of a student's lifetime Pell Grant eligibility already used, calculated from prior awards
acceptedZhAnswers: 佩尔助学金终身资格已用比例

examples.en: The handbook showed how Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used appeared in a student's aid record.
examples.zh: 手册展示了「佩尔助学金终身资格已用比例」在学生助学记录里的呈现方式。

examples.en: The adviser checked Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used before discussing the student's remaining grant eligibility.
examples.zh: 顾问先核对了「佩尔助学金终身资格已用比例」，再谈这名学生还剩多少助学金额度。

collocations: review Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used
check Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used
report Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used

words.zhGloss: 佩尔助学金年度追加安排
words.enDefinition: a US provision allowing eligible students to receive additional Pell Grant funds within the same award year
acceptedZhAnswers: 佩尔助学金年度追加安排

examples.en: The university adviser mentioned Year-Round Pell while explaining aid for an additional term of study.
examples.zh: 大学顾问解释额外一个学期的资助时，提到了「佩尔助学金年度追加安排」。

examples.en: The example with Year-Round Pell included an additional payment after the regular academic terms ended.
examples.zh: 「佩尔助学金年度追加安排」的例子在常规学期结束后还列有一次额外发放。

collocations: receive additional aid through Year-Round Pell

words.zhGloss: 佩尔助学金计算所用修读比例
words.enDefinition: the share of a full-time course load a student takes for purposes of calculating Pell Grant amounts
acceptedZhAnswers: 佩尔助学金计算所用修读比例

examples.en: The aid office explained the Pell Grant enrollment intensity used for a student taking fewer credits.
examples.zh: 助学办公室解释了，学分数较少的学生采用什么「佩尔助学金计算所用修读比例」。

examples.en: We compared the Pell Grant enrollment intensity in two examples with different numbers of credits.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两个学分数不同的例子中的「佩尔助学金计算所用修读比例」。

collocations: check the Pell Grant enrollment intensity

words.enDefinition: an award that exceeds the aid amount permitted under the applicable rules for a student

examples.en: The adviser spotted a financial aid overaward after a new outside scholarship appeared on the record.
examples.zh: 记录里多了一笔外部奖学金后，顾问发现了「助学资助核定超额」。

examples.en: Our sample notice showed how the school might resolve a financial aid overaward before paying aid.
examples.zh: 样本通知展示了学校在发放前可能怎样处理「助学资助核定超额」。

words.enDefinition: grant funds already paid in excess of the amount the recipient was entitled to receive

examples.en: The office found a grant overpayment when it compared the actual payment with the corrected award.
examples.zh: 办公室将实付金额与更正后核定的金额比较，发现了「助学金超额发放」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the grant overpayment was shown in the practice student's account statement.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「助学金超额发放」如何显示在练习用的学生账户对账单中。

words.zhGloss: 外部奖学金挤减原资助
words.enDefinition: a reduction in previously offered aid after a student receives an additional scholarship
acceptedZhAnswers: 外部奖学金挤减原资助

examples.en: The student newspaper interviewed the aid director about scholarship displacement after several students received outside awards.
examples.zh: 几名学生获得外部资助后，校报就「外部奖学金挤减原资助」采访了助学部门负责人。

examples.en: Our example showed scholarship displacement when a separate scholarship reduced another part of the aid package.
examples.zh: 我们的例子展示了单独获得的奖学金使资助组合中另一部分减少时，什么叫「外部奖学金挤减原资助」。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship given by an organisation other than the school the student attends

examples.en: The university asked me to report an outside scholarship awarded by a local community foundation.
examples.zh: 学校请我报告当地社区基金会发给我的「校外机构奖学金」。

examples.en: An outside scholarship appeared as a separate entry in my revised aid offer for the semester.
examples.zh: 这学期更新的资助方案把「校外机构奖学金」单列为一项。

words.enDefinition: a proportional adjustment to a student loan limit based on factors such as enrolment or the length of study

examples.en: The loan officer explained loan proration using two students with different lengths of study.
examples.zh: 贷款工作人员用两名学习时长不同的学生举例说明「贷款额度按比例折算」。

examples.en: Our practice aid notice showed loan proration separately from an adjustment to the estimated tuition costs.
examples.zh: 练习通知把「贷款额度按比例折算」与预估学费的调整分开显示。

words.zhGloss: 美国国家学生贷款数据系统
words.enDefinition: the US Department of Education's central system for federal student aid loan and grant records
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国国家学生贷款数据系统

examples.en: The training guide identified the National Student Loan Data System as a source of federal aid history.
examples.zh: 培训指南将「美国国家学生贷款数据系统」列为联邦助学历史记录的来源。

examples.en: The adviser explained what loan information came from the National Student Loan Data System in our example.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了案例里的哪些贷款信息来自「美国国家学生贷款数据系统」。

collocations: records in the National Student Loan Data System
data from the National Student Loan Data System
check the National Student Loan Data System

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦直接合并贷款
words.enDefinition: a US federal loan that combines eligible federal education loans into a single new loan
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦直接合并贷款

examples.en: The workbook used a Direct Consolidation Loan to illustrate replacing several federal student loans with one.
examples.zh: 练习册用「美国联邦直接合并贷款」说明怎样用一笔贷款替代多笔联邦学生贷款。

examples.en: An adviser explained how the Direct Consolidation Loan appeared separately in the sample borrower's records.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么示例借款人的记录里「美国联邦直接合并贷款」单列一项。

collocations: apply for a Direct Consolidation Loan

words.zhGloss: 美国公共服务贷款豁免
words.enDefinition: a US federal programme for cancelling remaining qualifying Direct Loan debt when its public service and payment rules are met
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国公共服务贷款豁免

examples.en: The handbook compared Public Service Loan Forgiveness with other ways a federal student loan might be cancelled.
examples.zh: 手册比较了「美国公共服务贷款豁免」和其他可取消联邦学生贷款的途径。

examples.en: Our workshop explained why documents about Public Service Loan Forgiveness referred to both employment and payments.
examples.zh: 工作坊解释了为什么「美国公共服务贷款豁免」的材料会同时提到就业和还款。

collocations: apply for Public Service Loan Forgiveness
track Public Service Loan Forgiveness progress

words.enDefinition: the number of payments or credited months that meet a programme's loan forgiveness conditions

examples.en: The borrower checked the qualifying payment count in the federal public service forgiveness record online.
examples.zh: 借款人在联邦公共服务豁免的在线记录里查了「合格还款次数」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why the qualifying payment count differed from the number of transactions shown.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么「合格还款次数」跟列出的交易笔数不一样。

words.enDefinition: the public organisation that administers student finance and student loan repayments in the UK

examples.en: The borrower asked the Student Loans Company to explain a line on the annual statement.
examples.zh: 借款人请「英国学生贷款公司」解释年度对账单上的一行。

examples.en: Our guide identified the Student Loans Company as the organisation responsible for the repayment account.
examples.zh: 指南指出，「英国学生贷款公司」负责管理还款账户。

collocations: letter from the Student Loans Company

words.enDefinition: the service that assesses and administers student finance applications for students applying under English funding arrangements

examples.en: I asked Student Finance England where the revised entitlement notice would appear in the account.
examples.zh: 我向「英格兰学生资助服务」询问，更新后的资助通知会显示在账户的什么位置。

examples.en: The campus adviser explained which questions should go to Student Finance England rather than the university.
examples.zh: 校园顾问解释了哪些问题该问「英格兰学生资助服务」，不能只问学校。

words.enDefinition: the service that administers student finance applications made under Welsh funding arrangements

examples.en: We used a sample letter from Student Finance Wales to practise reading the funding summary.
examples.zh: 我们用「威尔士学生资助服务」的样本信练习阅读资助摘要。

examples.en: The adviser showed us where Student Finance Wales displayed the amount of living-cost support awarded.
examples.zh: 顾问给我们指了「威尔士学生资助服务」在哪里显示核定的生活费资助金额。

words.zhGloss: 北爱尔兰学生资助服务
words.enDefinition: the service handling student finance applications under Northern Ireland's funding arrangements
acceptedZhAnswers: 北爱尔兰学生资助服务

examples.en: The prospectus directed applicants with funding questions to Student Finance Northern Ireland for further information.
examples.zh: 招生简章请有资助疑问的申请人向「北爱尔兰学生资助服务」了解更多信息。

examples.en: I read an example from Student Finance Northern Ireland about receiving separate tuition and maintenance support.
examples.zh: 我读了「北爱尔兰学生资助服务」的一个例子，里面的学费和生活费资助是分开提供的。

collocations: apply through Student Finance Northern Ireland

words.enDefinition: the Scottish public agency that assesses student funding applications and administers support including tuition assistance and bursaries

examples.en: The college guide mentioned the Student Awards Agency Scotland beside its section on bursaries.
examples.zh: 学院指南在助学金章节旁提到了「苏格兰学生资助署」。

examples.en: We compared a form from the Student Awards Agency Scotland with a sample form from England.
examples.zh: 我们把「苏格兰学生资助署」的一份表格与英格兰的一份样表作了比较。

collocations: apply to the Student Awards Agency Scotland
contact the Student Awards Agency Scotland

words.zhGloss: 英国学生贷款还款方案一
words.enDefinition: a UK student loan repayment category that includes Northern Ireland loans and some older English or Welsh loans
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生贷款还款方案一

examples.en: The sample Plan 1 letter was for someone who had borrowed through Student Finance Northern Ireland.
examples.zh: 这封「英国学生贷款还款方案一」样本信面向通过北爱尔兰学生资助服务借款的人。

examples.en: Our class compared the official Plan 1 description with summaries for other UK repayment plans.
examples.zh: 我们班把官方对「英国学生贷款还款方案一」的说明和其他英国还款方案的摘要作了比较。

words.zhGloss: 英国学生贷款还款方案二
words.enDefinition: a UK student loan repayment category covering specified English and Welsh loans, depending on the course and dates
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生贷款还款方案二

examples.en: A guide used Plan 2 as its example when explaining why course dates matter for repayment.
examples.zh: 有份指南用「英国学生贷款还款方案二」举例，解释课程日期为什么与还款有关。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to Plan 2 on the sample account before discussing other repayment categories.
examples.zh: 顾问先指出示例账户上的「英国学生贷款还款方案二」，再介绍其他还款类别。

words.zhGloss: 英国学生贷款还款方案四
words.enDefinition: the UK student loan repayment category for loans taken through the Student Awards Agency Scotland
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生贷款还款方案四

examples.en: The workbook showed Plan 4 for a borrower funded through the Student Awards Agency Scotland.
examples.zh: 练习册用「英国学生贷款还款方案四」举例，借款人通过苏格兰学生资助署获得资助。

examples.en: I read the Plan 4 heading while comparing the official summaries of the UK plans.
examples.zh: 我在对比英国各方案的官方摘要时，读到了「英国学生贷款还款方案四」这个标题。

words.zhGloss: 英国学生贷款还款方案五
words.enDefinition: a UK student loan repayment category for certain newer loans administered under English student finance arrangements
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生贷款还款方案五

examples.en: The example referred to Plan 5 for a newer undergraduate loan under Student Finance England.
examples.zh: 例子在谈英格兰学生资助服务下较新的本科贷款时，提到了「英国学生贷款还款方案五」。

examples.en: The adviser used a Plan 5 notice to show where the repayment category was printed.
examples.zh: 顾问拿了「英国学生贷款还款方案五」通知，展示还款类别印在哪里。

words.zhGloss: 英国研究生贷款还款方案
words.enDefinition: a UK repayment category for eligible English or Welsh postgraduate master's and doctoral student loans
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国研究生贷款还款方案

examples.en: My online account shows a Postgraduate Loan plan alongside a different plan for undergraduate study.
examples.zh: 我的在线账户既显示「英国研究生贷款还款方案」，也显示另一种本科贷款还款方案。

examples.en: The guide displayed the Postgraduate Loan plan in a separate row from the undergraduate examples.
examples.zh: 指南把「英国研究生贷款还款方案」与本科贷款示例分行列出。

collocations: payments under a Postgraduate Loan plan

words.enDefinition: a UK student loan account document confirming which repayment plan or plans the borrower is on

examples.en: The payroll officer asked for an active plan type letter to verify the borrower's repayment category.
examples.zh: 工资核算人员要求出示「当前还款方案证明信」，以核对借款人的还款类别。

examples.en: The borrower downloaded the active plan type letter after noticing two plans listed in the account.
examples.zh: 借款人看到账户里列了两个方案后，下载了「当前还款方案证明信」。

collocations: download an active plan type letter
show your active plan type letter
check the active plan type letter

words.enDefinition: a UK student finance notice setting out the support awarded and payment details, as used by Student Finance England

examples.en: The Student Finance Notification of Entitlement listed the amounts due at the start of each term.
examples.zh: 「学生资助核定通知」列出了各学期开始时应发的金额。

examples.en: We read a sample Student Finance Notification of Entitlement during the adviser training session that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午的顾问培训中，我们读了一份「学生资助核定通知」的样本。

collocations: receive a Student Finance Notification of Entitlement
check the Student Finance Notification of Entitlement
show your Student Finance Notification of Entitlement

words.enDefinition: in UK student finance, an identifier assigned to a person for their correspondence and account records

examples.en: The sample notice showed the customer reference number near the name of the funding service.
examples.zh: 样本通知在资助服务机构名称旁列了「学生资助客户编号」。

examples.en: I checked which customer reference number the adviser meant while reviewing the student finance letter.
examples.zh: 查看学生资助信函时，我核实了顾问说的是哪个「学生资助客户编号」。

collocations: customer reference number on the letter

words.enDefinition: a yearly summary that may show the loan balance, interest and payments for the period

examples.en: The student loan annual statement displayed the previous balance beside the balance at year end.
examples.zh: 「学生贷款年度对账单」把先前的余额和年末余额并排列出。

examples.en: The adviser showed how interest and repayments appeared on a sample student loan annual statement.
examples.zh: 顾问示范了利息与还款怎样显示在「学生贷款年度对账单」样本上。

collocations: view a student loan annual statement
read the student loan annual statement
request a student loan annual statement

words.enDefinition: in UK student finance, confirmation from a university or college that a student has registered on the course

examples.en: The funding portal was still waiting for confirmation of registration two days after classes started.
examples.zh: 开课两天后，资助门户还在等待学院发出「课程注册确认」。

examples.en: I asked whether confirmation of registration had been sent before the first payment was scheduled.
examples.zh: 我问，在安排首次发放前，学校有没有发出「课程注册确认」。

words.enDefinition: official confirmation from a provider that a student is attending the course, used in administering some funding

examples.en: The university sent confirmation of attendance after completing its checks for the start of term.
examples.zh: 大学完成开学核查后，发出了「课程到读确认」。

examples.en: The tuition funding guidance explained when the provider would submit confirmation of attendance to the funding service.
examples.zh: 学费资助指南说明了院校会在什么时候向资助机构提交「课程到读确认」。

words.enDefinition: funding intended to help cover living expenses while studying, such as a loan or grant

examples.en: The adviser explained which amount in the UK offer was maintenance support for living costs.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了英国资助方案里哪笔钱是供生活开支的「生活费资助」。

examples.en: The letter listed maintenance support on a separate page from the amount paid to the college.
examples.zh: 信函把「生活费资助」与付给学院的款项分在不同页上。

words.enDefinition: a non-repayable living-cost award under certain UK student finance arrangements, subject to programme eligibility

examples.en: The sample offer listed a maintenance grant beside a loan with a separate repayment section.
examples.zh: 示例资助方案把一笔「生活费助学金」和一笔单列还款说明的贷款并排列出。

examples.en: We checked the maintenance grant line in the example from a Welsh student finance guide.
examples.zh: 我们查看了威尔士学生资助指南示例中的「生活费助学金」一栏。

words.enDefinition: a review of household income used to work out how much financial support someone might receive

examples.en: The household income assessment showed which income figures the service used in the practice case.
examples.zh: 「家庭收入评估」显示了资助机构在练习案例中使用了哪些收入数据。

examples.en: The adviser separated the household income assessment from checks on the course and institution itself.
examples.zh: 顾问把「家庭收入评估」与对课程和院校本身的核查分开讲。

collocations: carry out a household income assessment
information for the household income assessment

words.zhGloss: 扣除规定扣减项后的家庭收入
words.enDefinition: income counted for a student funding assessment after the relevant allowances or deductions are applied
acceptedZhAnswers: 扣除规定扣减项后的家庭收入

examples.en: The sample calculation showed residual household income after deducting the allowances listed in the guide.
examples.zh: 例子按指南扣除规定项目，算出了「核定后的家庭收入」。

examples.en: Our adviser explained why residual household income differed from the combined income printed on payslips.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么「扣除规定扣减项后的家庭收入」与工资单上的收入合计不同。

words.enDefinition: an England student finance assessment based on current tax-year income rather than the usual earlier tax year

examples.en: The adviser used a current year income assessment example involving a recent fall in household income.
examples.zh: 顾问用一个家庭收入近期下降的例子，说明什么是「本税年收入重新评估」。

examples.en: I read where the current year income assessment was recorded on the example funding application.
examples.zh: 我查看了在示例资助申请的哪里记录「本税年收入重新评估」。

collocations: request a current year income assessment
complete a current year income assessment

words.enDefinition: an assumed amount of household support used when assessing some Student Finance England maintenance awards

examples.en: The adviser explained how the household contribution affected the amount shown on the entitlement notice.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「核定的家庭分担额」如何影响资助核定通知上的金额。

examples.en: The workbook calculated the household contribution before showing the final level of maintenance support available.
examples.zh: 练习册先计算「核定的家庭分担额」，再显示最终可获得的生活费资助。

words.zhGloss: 不按经济状况核定的资助
words.enDefinition: financial support whose availability or amount does not depend on the recipient's assessed means
acceptedZhAnswers: 不按经济状况核定的资助

examples.en: The handbook described non-means-tested support separately from amounts based on the household's assessed income.
examples.zh: 手册把「不按经济状况核定的资助」与依据家庭评估收入计算的金额分开介绍。

examples.en: We compared two sample notices showing non-means-tested support and a separate income-assessed amount for living costs.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两份样本通知，都列有「不按经济状况核定的资助」，另列按收入评估的生活费金额。

words.enDefinition: separate portions of a payment scheduled by academic term rather than paid all at once

examples.en: The notice showed three termly instalments with different dates over the course of the year.
examples.zh: 通知列出了本年度日期各不相同的三笔「每学期分期款」。

examples.en: I copied the dates of the termly instalments into the budgeting worksheet for my course.
examples.zh: 我把「每学期分期款」的日期抄到了课程用的预算表里。

words.enDefinition: a Student Finance England payment status indicating that the course provider's confirmation of registration has not yet been received

examples.en: The example account showed Awaiting confirmation while the service waited to hear from the university.
examples.zh: 示例账户显示「正在等待确认」，资助机构还在等学校回复。

examples.en: Our trainer asked what Awaiting confirmation meant in the payment status column of the worksheet.
examples.zh: 培训老师问，练习表发放状态栏里的「正在等待确认」是什么意思。

collocations: check why it says Awaiting confirmation

words.enDefinition: a Student Finance England payment status indicating that no further information is needed and payment is scheduled for the date shown

examples.en: The online example changed to Ready to be paid after the university confirmed registration.
examples.zh: 大学确认注册后，在线示例的状态变成了「已安排发放」。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to distinguish Ready to be paid from a payment already received.
examples.zh: 顾问请我区分「已安排发放」和已经到账的款项。

collocations: status shows Ready to be paid
listed as Ready to be paid
change to Ready to be paid

words.enDefinition: amounts taken from a worker's pay to repay a student loan under a payroll system

examples.en: The employee checked the student loan deductions on the practice payslip from the UK workshop.
examples.zh: 那名员工核对了英国工作坊工资单样本上的「学生贷款代扣还款额」。

examples.en: The payroll guide displayed student loan deductions in a different row from income tax.
examples.zh: 工资核算指南把「学生贷款代扣还款额」与所得税分行显示。

words.zhGloss: 学生贷款剩余余额免还日期
words.enDefinition: the date on which remaining student loan debt is scheduled to be cancelled if applicable conditions are met
acceptedZhAnswers: 学生贷款剩余余额免还日期

examples.en: The adviser noted the write-off date while comparing the two example UK student loan plans.
examples.zh: 顾问在比较两个英国学生贷款示例方案时，留意了「学生贷款剩余余额免还日期」。

examples.en: The sample account showed the write-off date separately from the dates of recent monthly repayments.
examples.zh: 示例账户把「学生贷款剩余余额免还日期」与最近各月的还款日期分开显示。

words.zhGloss: 在境外期间的收入评估
words.enDefinition: an assessment of income and circumstances used to calculate UK student loan repayments for borrowers living abroad
acceptedZhAnswers: 在境外期间的收入评估

examples.en: The borrower's guide showed where overseas income assessment appeared in the section for people living abroad.
examples.zh: 借款人指南展示了在面向境外居住人士的章节哪里出现「在境外期间的收入评估」。

examples.en: The adviser explained which country the overseas income assessment applied to in the example letter.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了示例信里的「在境外期间的收入评估」适用于哪个国家。

words.zhGloss: 境外还款起征收入门槛
words.enDefinition: the minimum income level used to determine repayments for a borrower living outside the UK, based on their plan and country
acceptedZhAnswers: 境外还款起征收入门槛

examples.en: We located the overseas repayment threshold in the table before working through the sample calculation.
examples.zh: 我们先在表中找到「境外还款起征收入门槛」，再做示例计算。

examples.en: The two examples used a different overseas repayment threshold because the borrowers lived in different countries.
examples.zh: 两例使用的「境外还款起征收入门槛」不同，因为借款人住在不同国家。

collocations: look up the overseas repayment threshold
overseas repayment threshold for a country

words.enDefinition: a set monthly amount the Student Loans Company may apply when it lacks required income information for a borrower living overseas

examples.en: The sample overseas account showed a fixed monthly repayment rather than an amount based on reported income.
examples.zh: 该示例的境外账户显示「境外核定月还款额」，金额与依据申报收入计算的款项不同。

examples.en: The adviser explained what fixed monthly repayment referred to in the sample overseas repayment notice.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了境外还款样本通知中「境外核定月还款额」指什么。

words.zhGloss: 在境外期间累积的欠款
words.enDefinition: overdue UK student loan repayments accrued while the borrower lived abroad
acceptedZhAnswers: 在境外期间累积的欠款

examples.en: The sample statement displayed overseas arrears in a separate section from the current monthly amount.
examples.zh: 样本对账单把「在境外期间累积的欠款」与当前月度金额分开列出。

examples.en: The loan adviser explained what the overseas arrears line meant in the fictitious borrower record.
examples.zh: 贷款顾问解释了虚构借款人记录中的「在境外期间累积的欠款」一栏是什么意思。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大学生贷款服务中心
words.enDefinition: the Canadian service where borrowers manage participating government student loans and repayments
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大学生贷款服务中心

examples.en: The National Student Loans Service Centre appeared on the sample statement beside the borrower's account details.
examples.zh: 样本对账单在借款人账户详情旁显示了「加拿大学生贷款服务中心」。

examples.en: Our adviser explained which loan records were held at the National Student Loans Service Centre.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了哪些贷款记录保存在「加拿大学生贷款服务中心」。

collocations: contact the National Student Loans Service Centre
National Student Loans Service Centre account
statement from the National Student Loans Service Centre

words.zhGloss: 加拿大学生经济资助计划
words.enDefinition: the Canadian federal programme providing grants and loans for eligible students in post-secondary education
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大学生经济资助计划

examples.en: The booklet introduced the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program before listing its federal grants and loans.
examples.zh: 小册子先介绍「加拿大学生经济资助计划」，再列出其中的联邦助学金和贷款。

examples.en: The class discussed how provinces work with the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program to provide funding.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了各省如何与「加拿大学生经济资助计划」配合提供资助。

collocations: funding under the Canada Student Financial Assistance Program
Canada Student Financial Assistance Program grants
Canada Student Financial Assistance Program eligibility

words.expression: Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students
words.lemma: canada student grant for full-time students
words.zhGloss: 加拿大全日制学生助学金
words.enDefinition: a Canadian federal grant for eligible full-time post-secondary students with financial need
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大全日制学生助学金
acceptedEnVariants: Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students

examples.en: The sample aid package listed the Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students before showing the loan amount.
examples.zh: 示例资助组合先列出「加拿大全日制学生助学金」，再显示贷款金额。

examples.en: We saw the Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students in a guide to Canadian federal aid.
examples.zh: 我们在加拿大联邦资助指南里看到了「加拿大全日制学生助学金」。

collocations: receive the Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students
Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students eligibility
amount of the Canada Student Grant for Full-Time Students

words.expression: Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students
words.lemma: canada student grant for part-time students
words.zhGloss: 加拿大非全日制学生助学金
words.enDefinition: a Canadian federal grant for eligible part-time post-secondary students with financial need
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大非全日制学生助学金
acceptedEnVariants: Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students

examples.en: The adviser explained which figure in the example was the Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了案例中的哪个数额对应「加拿大非全日制学生助学金」。

examples.en: The workbook compared the Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students with an amount offered as a loan.
examples.zh: 练习册把「加拿大非全日制学生助学金」与作为贷款提供的款项作了比较。

collocations: receive the Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students
Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students eligibility
assessment for the Canada Student Grant for Part-Time Students

words.expression: Canada Student Grant for Students with Disabilities
words.lemma: canada student grant for students with disabilities
words.zhGloss: 加拿大残障学生助学金
words.enDefinition: a Canadian federal student grant for eligible students with disabilities
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大残障学生助学金
acceptedEnVariants: Canada Student Grant for Students with Disabilities

examples.en: The financial aid office listed the Canada Student Grant for Students with Disabilities as a federal grant.
examples.zh: 助学办公室把「加拿大残障学生助学金」列在联邦助学金中。

examples.en: The sample assessment showed the Canada Student Grant for Students with Disabilities separately from equipment funding.
examples.zh: 示例评估把「加拿大残障学生助学金」和器材资助分开显示。

collocations: Canada Student Grant for Students with Disabilities eligibility
receive the Canada Student Grant for Students with Disabilities
information on the Canada Student Grant for Students with Disabilities

words.expression: Canada Student Grant for Services and Equipment for Students with Disabilities
words.lemma: canada student grant for services and equipment for students with disabilities
words.zhGloss: 加拿大残障学生服务及设备助学金
words.enDefinition: Canadian federal funding for eligible education-related services and equipment needed by a student with a disability
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大残障学生服务及设备助学金
acceptedEnVariants: Canada Student Grant for Services and Equipment for Students with Disabilities

examples.en: The Canada Student Grant for Services and Equipment for Students with Disabilities appeared on our sample worksheet.
examples.zh: 示例练习表上出现了「加拿大残障学生服务及设备助学金」。

examples.en: We discussed eligibility for the Canada Student Grant for Services and Equipment for Students with Disabilities today.
examples.zh: 今天我们讨论了「加拿大残障学生服务及设备助学金」的资格条件。

collocations: funding through the Canada Student Grant for Services and Equipment for Students with Disabilities
details of the Canada Student Grant for Services and Equipment for Students with Disabilities
apply for the Canada Student Grant for Services and Equipment for Students with Disabilities

words.enDefinition: a Canadian federal loan to help eligible students cover costs of post-secondary studies

examples.en: The sample award notice listed the Canada Student Loan separately from the provincial grant amount.
examples.zh: 资助样本通知把「加拿大联邦学生贷款」与省级助学金的金额分别列出。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the Canada Student Loan balance appeared in the borrower's example account.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「加拿大联邦学生贷款」余额如何显示在示例借款人账户上。

words.enDefinition: a Canadian federal loan programme supporting eligible apprentices during periods of technical training

examples.en: The trades programme guide discussed the Canada Apprentice Loan in its section on funding technical training.
examples.zh: 技工项目指南在资助技术培训的章节讨论了「加拿大学徒贷款」。

examples.en: The adviser showed where a Canada Apprentice Loan would appear in an example aid record.
examples.zh: 顾问指出「加拿大学徒贷款」会显示在示例资助记录的什么位置。

words.zhGloss: 联邦与省合并发放的学生贷款
words.enDefinition: a loan administered jointly under Canadian federal and participating provincial student aid arrangements
acceptedZhAnswers: 联邦与省合并发放的学生贷款

examples.en: The borrower had an integrated student loan with federal and provincial portions on the same statement.
examples.zh: 借款人有一笔「联邦与省合并发放的学生贷款」，同一份对账单显示两个部分。

examples.en: The adviser used an integrated student loan to explain why the statement showed two balances.
examples.zh: 顾问以一笔「联邦与省合并发放的学生贷款」解释对账单为什么显示两个余额。

collocations: balance on an integrated student loan

words.enDefinition: the part of a Canadian student loan funded by a province rather than the federal government

examples.en: The provincial portion appeared underneath the federal amount on the Canadian sample repayment statement.
examples.zh: 加拿大还款样本对账单把「贷款的省级部分」列在联邦金额下方。

examples.en: We checked whether the provincial portion had a separate line for interest in the example.
examples.zh: 我们查了示例有没有为「贷款的省级部分」单列利息一栏。

words.enDefinition: the part of a Canadian student loan funded by the federal government

examples.en: The sample statement showed the federal portion in a separate line from provincial funding.
examples.zh: 样本对账单把「贷款的联邦部分」和省级资助分行显示。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to the federal portion before explaining how to read the combined balance.
examples.zh: 顾问先指出「贷款的联邦部分」，再解释如何读合计余额。

words.enDefinition: provincial funding such as student grants or loans provided under a Canadian province's rules

examples.en: The college adviser explained where information about provincial student aid appeared in the local admissions guide.
examples.zh: 学院顾问解释了在本地招生指南哪里可以看到「省级学生资助」的信息。

examples.en: The sample assessment showed provincial student aid in addition to the amounts listed under federal programmes.
examples.zh: 示例评估除了列出联邦计划的金额，也显示了「省级学生资助」。

words.zhGloss: 佩尔助学金全日制全年核定额
words.enDefinition: the amount a student would receive in Pell Grant aid for full-time attendance over a full academic year
acceptedZhAnswers: 佩尔助学金全日制全年核定额

examples.en: Our adviser compared the Pell Grant Scheduled Award with the actual award for reduced enrolment.
examples.zh: 顾问把「佩尔助学金全日制全年核定额」与减少修读量后实际核定的金额作了比较。

examples.en: The worksheet used the Pell Grant Scheduled Award before adjusting the payment for enrollment intensity.
examples.zh: 练习表先列「佩尔助学金全日制全年核定额」，再按修读量比例调整发放金额。

collocations: calculate the Pell Grant Scheduled Award
determine the Pell Grant Scheduled Award
note the Pell Grant Scheduled Award

words.zhGloss: 澳洲联邦必修实习补助
words.enDefinition: an Australian payment for eligible domestic students during mandatory placements in specified programmes

words.enDefinition: adjustment of a debt or amount in line with a specified index, as for Australian HELP debt

examples.en: The account example displayed indexation in a separate line from the original HELP loan amount.
examples.zh: 账户示例把「按指数调整贷款余额」单列一行，与原先的 HELP 贷款金额分开。

examples.en: The adviser explained how indexation could change the balance shown in a later year.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「按指数调整贷款余额」怎样改变以后年份显示的余额。

words.enDefinition: the percentage set for a given year's indexation of an amount such as eligible HELP debt

examples.en: The guide used a sample annual indexation rate to show how part of the balance changed.
examples.zh: 指南用了一个模拟的「年度指数调整率」来展示部分余额怎样变化。

examples.en: The adviser compared the annual indexation rate with the figure shown for the previous year.
examples.zh: 顾问把「年度指数调整率」与上一年显示的数字作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a rate applied to the part of Australian repayment income that falls within a relevant bracket, where marginal rates apply

examples.en: Our class used a marginal repayment rate to calculate an example Australian student loan repayment.
examples.zh: 课堂上我们采用「边际还款比率」计算一笔澳洲助学贷款的示例还款。

examples.en: The adviser explained which marginal repayment rate applied to that part of the example income.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了示例收入的这部分适用哪个「边际还款比率」。

collocations: marginal repayment rate for a bracket

words.enDefinition: a study loan repayment required by Australian rules, usually calculated as part of the tax assessment

examples.en: The example notice included a compulsory repayment and listed its amount separately from income tax.
examples.zh: 样本通知里有一笔「强制还款额」，其金额与所得税分开列出。

examples.en: The adviser explained where the compulsory repayment appeared in the Australian tax assessment example.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「强制还款额」在澳大利亚税务评估示例的什么位置。

words.zhGloss: 自愿偿还 HELP 贷款款项
words.enDefinition: a payment a borrower chooses to make towards an Australian HELP debt in addition to any required repayment
acceptedZhAnswers: 自愿偿还 HELP 贷款款项

examples.en: The sample account showed a voluntary HELP repayment entered before the end of the year.
examples.zh: 示例账户显示，年底前录入了一笔「自愿偿还 HELP 贷款款项」。

examples.en: The adviser distinguished a voluntary HELP repayment from the amount recorded on the tax assessment.
examples.zh: 顾问区分了「自愿偿还 HELP 贷款款项」和税务评估上记的还款金额。

collocations: the date of a voluntary HELP repayment

words.zhGloss: 澳洲助学贷款还款核算收入
words.enDefinition: income calculated under Australian tax rules to determine compulsory study or training loan repayments
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳洲助学贷款还款核算收入

examples.en: The example used repayment income to determine the relevant row in the Australian repayment table.
examples.zh: 例子用「澳洲助学贷款还款核算收入」确定适用澳大利亚还款表里的哪一行。

examples.en: The adviser explained why repayment income was different from the person's taxable income in the example.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么示例中「澳洲助学贷款还款核算收入」和个人应税收入不同。

collocations: compare repayment income with the threshold

words.zhGloss: 恢复已用的 HELP 可借额度
words.enDefinition: to restore part of a student's available HELP borrowing amount in circumstances permitted by Australian rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 恢复已用的 HELP 可借额度

examples.en: The training case asked whether the university could re-credit a HELP balance after reviewing the records.
examples.zh: 培训案例问，核查记录后大学能不能「恢复已用的 HELP 可借额度」。

examples.en: The adviser explained what it means to re-credit a HELP balance in a sample withdrawal case.
examples.zh: 顾问用退课案例解释了「恢复已用的 HELP 可借额度」是什么意思。

collocations: a decision to re-credit a HELP balance
request to re-credit a HELP balance
when to re-credit a HELP balance

words.enDefinition: the New Zealand government service administering student loans, allowances and related student support

examples.en: The university adviser directed us to StudyLink for an official overview of New Zealand funding.
examples.zh: 大学顾问让我们去「新西兰学生资助服务」看官方的资助概览。

examples.en: Our workshop used a sample notice from StudyLink to show how payment information was organised.
examples.zh: 工作坊用「新西兰学生资助服务」的通知样本说明付款信息怎样组织。

words.enDefinition: a New Zealand payment that helps eligible students with living expenses and is generally not repaid

examples.en: The New Zealand guide described a Student Allowance in a different section from borrowed living costs.
examples.zh: 新西兰指南把「新西兰学生生活津贴」与借贷支付的生活费分在不同章节。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the Student Allowance appeared in the sample weekly payment notice.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「新西兰学生生活津贴」如何列在每周付款通知样本里。

words.enDefinition: in New Zealand's Student Loan scheme, fees required by an education provider for enrolment in a course

examples.en: The New Zealand sample loan covered compulsory course fees paid directly to the education provider.
examples.zh: 新西兰的示例贷款用于「必缴课程费用」，款项直接付给院校。

examples.en: The adviser distinguished compulsory course fees from the cost of textbooks bought separately.
examples.zh: 顾问把「必缴课程费用」和单独购买教科书的开支区分开。

collocations: compulsory course fees charged by the provider

words.enDefinition: in New Zealand's Student Loan scheme, a borrowing component for expenses such as books or equipment used for study

examples.en: The New Zealand example showed course-related costs for books separately from fees paid to the provider.
examples.zh: 新西兰的例子把购书用的「课程相关开支」与付给院校的费用分开显示。

examples.en: Our guide listed a few course-related costs that a student might see in a funding estimate.
examples.zh: 指南列了几项学生可能在资助估算看到的「课程相关开支」。

words.enDefinition: money borrowed through the New Zealand Student Loan scheme to help with living costs during study

examples.en: The sample showed Student Loan living costs as borrowed money alongside a separate line for grants.
examples.zh: 样本把「学生贷款生活费部分」列为借款，另列一行助学金。

examples.en: The adviser distinguished Student Loan living costs from the amount borrowed to pay compulsory fees.
examples.zh: 顾问把「学生贷款生活费部分」与借来支付必缴费用的金额区分开。
